about_the_game:
Bob Goblin must set traps in his islands dungeons in order to defend against the invading adventurers! As the goblins on the island are to weak to fight back against dangerous foes like paladins and rogues, Bob must place traps and lure enemies in order to secure his and his fellow goblin islanders safety. Explore a fun and unique pixel art world as you journey from your home island to protecting the whole land. Protect your fellow goblins and your islands! 

Demo Features:

  • Trapsetter is an arcade adventure with light roguelike elements. Randomized items make each playthrough a little different.

  • Set different traps, such as bear traps, spear traps, wooden spikes, and more, each with a unique effect! 

  • Demo features one level and boss.
